Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You bow and extend a hand as though inviting your enemy to dance. An unseen tug draws them across the ground toward you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 4 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Offer the impossible courtesy of a dance-step somewhere else. Magical force moves the target; it does not compel agreement or belief.

Weak
Pull it 1 square toward you.
Standard
Pull it 2 squares.
Strong
Pull it 2 squares; you may move 1 square without provoking afterward.
